prompt:
I have a directory tree:
/home/user/project/
  ├── src/
  │   ├── main.py
  │   └── utils.py
  ├── tests/
  │   └── test_main.py
  ├── requirements.txt
  └── README.md

Give me the EXACT bash commands to: (1) cd into the project, (2) count Python files, (3) count total lines of Python code, (4) find any function called 'process_' across files, (5) run pytest with verbose output redirected to /tmp/pytest.log, (6) show the last 10 lines of that log. Each command on its own line, numbered 1-6. No commentary.

result.content:
1. cd /home/user/project
2. find . -name "*.py" | wc -l
3. find . -name "*.py" -exec cat {} + | wc -l
4. grep -rn "def process_" .
5. pytest -v > /tmp/pytest.log 2>&1
6. tail -10 /tmp/pytest.log
